## Protocol and precision

- Qwen3.5-2B and 4B use the same pinned checkpoints with BF16 large matrices; some checkpoint norm weights are FP32. vLLM load logs report casting some of these norms into BF16 parameters. Exact norm-weight/intermediate precision is therefore not matched across engines. Garnet counts the shared BF16 embedding/head once. Original Garnet cohorts exclude unused MTP weights and have speculation OFF; experimental MTP cohorts include their engines/buffers.
- Correction (October23): saved LM Studio2B batches1/2/4/8 actually use MTP, with28/56/112/224 draft-acceptance events. The requested false flag did not establish execution. Saved LM4B logs have no drafting events, so their speculation status remains unresolved. Original vLLM cohorts configure speculation OFF; additional tested MTP profiles are reported separately. Exact proposal settings are not matched. See [saved-comparator-speculation-audit.json](D:/CantorAI/work/qwen35-cuda/saved-comparator-speculation-audit.json). Earlier contrary descriptions are superseded; raw timing logs are unchanged.
- Garnet uses BF16 projection input/output with FP32 accumulation and reduced-precision reductions disabled; residual, norm, RoPE, attention and recurrent state are FP32. Other engines have different intermediate arithmetic. Equal BF16 source weights do not imply bit-exact execution.
- Current fixed workload: 320×192 real-image variants, 60 merged visual tokens, 85 prompt tokens, 32 output-token limit, reasoning off, greedy sampling. A unique8×8 corner tile is added to each invocation; source/JPEG/decoded-RGB hashes are saved. Four related image families are not a broad quality dataset.
- Seven rounds of four groups: two warmup rounds, five measured rounds. One model/engine/profile at a time. Batch groups contain B simultaneous requests inside that engine.
- Current partitioned LM cohorts verify B slots,512-token slot capacity and `kv_unified=false`. Earlier unified-pool LM cohorts are retained as provisional/historical. Their slot ceiling alone did not prove independent per-row capacity.
- Garnet and vLLM image hashes and prompt IDs must match. LM raw prompt IDs are unavailable; input counts and full prompt-evaluation logs are checked. Unique images and full prompt evaluations evidence actual work, not a verified setting disabling every internal cache.
- Equal-output groups below contain32 sampled tokens per row in every engine. Group completion latency is not aggregate throughput or individual streaming latency. API timing boundaries differ.

Protocol: [inputs/matched512-batches/manifest.json](D:/CantorAI/work/qwen35-cuda/inputs/matched512-batches/manifest.json). Configuration sources: [matched profile](../../test2026/cuda/qwen35_matched_benchmark_profiles.json), [development methods](qwen35-cuda-development-log.md).

All18 target-serial native integration profiles preserve states, tokens, stops, limits, rollback and one-context ownership. ## Deferred canonical state commit — measured4B batch8

The optional transaction borrows canonical state unchanged while target verification computes proposed outputs. Rollback restores small request buffers; accepted prefixes write canonical state only at the final commit. Pending transactions reject other parent mutation. A final-write failure poisons the decoder until reset. This removes the full canonical backup without changing the CUDA recurrence or precision. Default OFF.

All12 integration profiles exited0, including parent ownership, invalid-use, partial/full acceptance and injected failure recovery. The batch8 verifier and full24-case MTP session both passed unfiltered memcheck with zero errors. These controls do not resolve existing independent pretrained quality gaps.

The28-request real-image cohort measures 805.41ms versus 1129.04ms on 15common equal32groups, with all28/28 sequences unchanged. Retained ownership falls from15,534,163,516B to14,837,909,052B (-696,254,464B). vLLM measures665.65ms, LM Studio1348.27ms; the2× threshold332.82ms remains unmet.

## Native state-only prefix commit — experimental

The default-off nativePackedPrefixCommit route replaces the packed replay TensorRT graph with separate CUDA state-only kernels. It recomputes accepted convolution/recurrent state in place and copies only accepted KV slots from authoritative target outputs. The canonical state stays unchanged until this final commit; failed final writes poison the decoder. It requires the deferred-state and register128 profiles. Small convolution/dt/A_log parameters and convolution workspace are explicitly counted. TensorRT input/output aliasing is not used.

All12 numerical profiles pass exact ordinary-native states/outputs, including B1/2/4/8, C4/C16 and P32/P64. The B8 verifier and full24-case MTP session pass unfiltered memcheck. Racecheck/synccheck pass with zero findings for the three new packedCommit kernels inside the full MTP session; other kernels are excluded from these two checks. Invalid spans/layouts are rejected before mutation, and post-write injected failures require reset. These scopes do not replace missing full integration race/sync coverage or existing independent pretrained quality gaps.

The real4B B8 probe passes: two native-prefix requests followed by a separately loaded non-MTP target. Full finite target-state hashes stream bounded column chunks; timings are invalidated by diagnostic hashing. Evidence: [native-prefix-pretrained-4b-b8.json](D:/CantorAI/work/qwen35-cuda/native-prefix-pretrained-4b-b8.json).

## Logical SDK-view I/O correction

The original native implementation fails the new byte-boundary oracle: zeroing a middle token view also zeroes the following token. The original failure is retained. Zero, clone and copy now use validated contiguous logical element bytes, while preserving backing-storage owners, grouped access leases and partial-overlap rejection. All 8 boundary/lifetime cases pass normal execution and unfiltered memcheck, racecheck and synccheck. CUDA device fatbin bytes are identical to the preceding DLL; host behavior changed and is checked separately. The packing inference path reads its token views and had already passed full-state preservation; this correction protects general writable-view operations. Evidence: [logical-views-before-fix-exit.json](D:/CantorAI/work/qwen35-cuda/logical-views-before-fix-exit.json), [logical-views-fixed-plain.json](D:/CantorAI/work/qwen35-cuda/logical-views-fixed-plain.json), [logical-views-device-preservation.json](D:/CantorAI/work/qwen35-cuda/logical-views-device-preservation.json).

## Same-input joined projection component screen

## Managed decoder activation storage — implementation under validation

The working implementation adds an explicit user-managed context policy, one-context pools, a fixed per-decoder SDK buffer sized from the actual built-engine maximum, storage validation, overlap rejection and a shared WRITE lease in each input/output transaction. Python counts the single arena owner once. The profile defaults off. Current working DLL SHA256: `21b2a49e3384a433591c66ffee59a1e221a309f90bcc316a91ee38c17e19748a`; the device fatbin matches the preserved build. The joined model timing and process-memory measurements above are historical DLL3c measurements, not performance evidence for this new working build.

The first implementation (DLL2aa) passed all50 native/SDK output checks but failed unfiltered memcheck with one512-byte D2D use-after-free at runtime teardown. That failure is retained. A simpler default-workspace control did not reproduce it. Public compiled-graph outputs now use the tensor owner’s matching legacy allocation path; this corrects a documented allocation/cleanup mismatch but does not alone prove the full original failure’s cause. The original failing test source is unchanged for the rerun.
